name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable corepack and install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run tests for lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Typecheck lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Lint lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Build lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run build --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Install Wrangler CLI
        run: pnpm add -g @cloudflare/wrangler

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
        run: pnpm exec wrangler publish
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}

      - name: Sync lexical data to D1
        if: success()
        run: pnpm run sync --workspace lexical-search-worker
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}

name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable corepack and install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run tests for lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Typecheck lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Lint lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Build lexical-search-worker
        run: pnpm run build --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Install Wrangler CLI
        run: pnpm add -g @cloudflare/wrangler

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
        run: pnpm exec wrangler publish
        working-directory: services/lexical-search-worker
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          CF_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}

      - name: Sync lexical data to D1
        if: success()
        run: pnpm run sync --workspace lexical-search-worker

          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
